# kubic-kode

> kubic-kode is a Node.js framework for turn-based, session-based multiplayer browser games. You write one game class on the server (the GameContract); the framework provides sessions, lobby, turn order, game-token auth, computer players and WebSocket broadcasts; the browser talks to it only through the KubicKode helper (client/kubic-kode-helper/). ES modules only; not published to npm (clone it, or vendor it as a git submodule with a file: dependency).

## Docs

- [Building a Game](docs/building-a-game.md): complete small game (server class, server setup, browser page using the helper)
- [Concepts](docs/concepts.md): sessions, participants vs players, tokens, game lifecycle, connection handling, events
- [Helper Reference](docs/helper-reference.md): every browser helper method, route action, event, state field and config key
- [Server Reference](docs/server-reference.md): game contract, PlayStatus, GameEngine, options, createGameServer, env vars, HTTP routes, WebSocket protocol and broadcasts

## Optional

- [Module System](docs/module-system.md): extending the server with your own modules and hooks
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): local setup and running the test suite
